text:
maya: Quick sync — Ignite launch next Wed. Finalize launch post, 30m webinar, credit ladder, starter prompt pack, inbound routing.
noah: timeline?
maya: post Wed 9am PT, webinar Thu 11am PT, credits after webinar.
sam: primary KPI = activation (first 5 requests within 24h). secondary = D7 retention.
anya: baseline activation 22%, target +10pp.
rachel: social should include two mini prompts inline + CTA -> $20 credit. short + visual.
noah: routing rule: SDRs if company_size>50 OR mentions private/dedicated/compliance. others self-serve.
maya: can we probe with 10% low-fit -> SDRs to test uplift?
ops-bot: experiment flag sdr_probe=10% created.
sam: landing idea: 3 starter templates (support, summarizer, code-assist) so users can hit first-5 fast. seed those.
anya: A/B header: A) "Start with templates + $20" B) "Try Ignite: instant templates" — 50/50.
rachel: webinar plan: 8m product, 20m live prompt workshop, 12m Q&A. attendee incentive: extra $10 for first 3 live runs.
maya: finance ok?
noah: finance ok for promo pool $4k, per-account cap $50.
ops-bot: promo bucket 'ignite-webinar-2026' created; webhook /promo/claim active; idempotency required.
sam: telemetry: emit event template_run with template_id, tokens_used, success boolean; tag experiment_variant and signup_source.
maya: action items: noah — routing + handoff doc (EOD); ops — promo bucket + webhook (done); rachel+anya — landing + post copy + webinar script (first draft EOD); sam — seed templates + dashboard wiring (tomorrow AM).
rachel: drafting copy now, will ping for review.
anya: QA: signup -> claim -> auto-credit -> run template -> template_run event -> credits consumed. test idempotency and per-account cap.
maya: recap: social, blog benchmark narrative, webinar page, promo bucket, routing rules, template pack, dashboard widgets, QA. Thanks! :rocket:
